name: Households (in %) reporting expenditure, share of budget (in %) to total expenditure on transport and MPCE (in ₹) for different modes of transport
description: Households (in %) reporting expenditure, share of budget (in %) to total expenditure on transport and MPCE (in ₹) for different modes of transport
specification: Use this indicator when the query refers to rural and urban MPCE (₹), budget share (%) and share of households reporting spending, for each mode of transport (air, rail, bus/tram, taxi, auto rickshaw, etc.). Do not use this indicator for quintile-wise transport expenditure (use indicator 2) or non-transport services (use indicators 3, 4, 5 or 6).

name: MPCE (in ₹) on different modes of transport in different quintile UMPCE classes
description: MPCE (in ₹) on different modes of transport in different quintile UMPCE classes
specification: Use this indicator when the query refers to rural and urban MPCE (₹) on each mode of transport across the five UMPCE quintile classes (0–20% to 80–100%). Do not use this indicator for overall transport MPCE, budget share or households reporting expenditure (use indicator 1).

name: MPCE (in ₹), budget share (in %) and households (in %) reporting particular miscellaneous consumer services
description: MPCE (in ₹), budget share (in %) and households (in %) reporting particular miscellaneous consumer services
specification: Use this indicator when the query refers to rural and urban MPCE (₹), budget share (%) and share of households reporting spending, for each miscellaneous consumer service (communication, barber and beauty, TV and radio, repair, religious services, etc.). Do not use this indicator for quintile-wise expenditure (use indicator 4 or 5), transport (use indicator 1 or 2) or budget share within total consumer services expenditure (use indicator 6).

name: MPCE (in ₹) on miscellaneous consumer services in last 30 days for each quintile class of UMPCE
description: MPCE (in ₹) on miscellaneous consumer services in last 30 days for each quintile class of UMPCE
specification: Use this indicator when the query refers to rural and urban MPCE (₹) on each miscellaneous consumer service over the last 30 days, by UMPCE quintile class. Do not use this indicator for overall miscellaneous services expenditure, budget share or households reporting (use indicator 3) or repair, hotel lodging and hotel food (use indicator 5).

name: MPCE (in ₹) on services for each quintile class of UMPCE
description: MPCE (in ₹) on services for each quintile class of UMPCE
specification: Use this indicator when the query refers to rural and urban MPCE (₹) on repair and maintenance of selected items and hotel lodging, and on food in hotels, by UMPCE quintile class and overall. Do not use this indicator for miscellaneous consumer services by quintile (use indicator 4) or budget share of services (use indicator 6).

name: Budget-share (in %) of MPCE (in ₹) of different consumer services among total expenditure
description: Budget-share (in %) of MPCE (in ₹) of different consumer services among total expenditure
specification: Use this indicator when the query refers to rural and urban MPCE (₹) and budget share (%) of each consumer service (transport, hotel food, lodging and repair, and other services) within total expenditure on consumer services. Do not use this indicator for mode-wise transport details (use indicator 1) or quintile-wise expenditure (use indicators 2, 4 or 5).

name: Households (in %) having NAE and acquiring major durable goods in the households having NAE and not having NAE
description: Households (in %) having NAE and acquiring major durable goods in the households having NAE and not having NAE
specification: Use this indicator when the query refers to rural and urban share of households with a non-agricultural enterprise (NAE), and the share acquiring major durable goods among households with and without an NAE. Do not use this indicator for the distribution of acquiring households by UMPCE class (use indicator 8) or expenditure on durable goods (use indicators 9, 10 or 11).

name: Households (in %) acquiring major durable goods and their percentage distribution in the households having NAE and not having NAE
description: Households (in %) acquiring major durable goods and their percentage distribution in the households having NAE and not having NAE
specification: Use this indicator when the query asks for the percentage or proportion of households acquiring major durable goods, including the percentage of households acquiring durable goods among households having NAE or not having NAE, and the percentage distribution of acquiring households by NAE status. Use this indicator for rural, urban and combined areas, including All India and individual states/UTs, and by UMPCE class where available. Match queries containing terms such as 'percentage of households acquiring major durable goods', 'share of households that acquired durable goods', 'proportion of households purchasing durable goods', or 'households acquiring durable goods having NAE'. Do not use this indicator for the percentage of households having NAE itself (use indicator 7) or average MPCE, expenditure, or budget share on durable goods (use indicators 9, 10 or 11).

name: Average MPCE (in ₹) and budget-share(in %) on different broad groups of durable goods in last 365 days having NAE
description: Average MPCE (in ₹) and budget-share(in %) on different broad groups of durable goods in last 365 days having NAE
specification: Use this indicator when the query refers to rural and urban MPCE (₹) and budget share (%) on broad groups of durable goods bought over the last 365 days by NAE households, split by main use (enterprise vs domestic). Do not use this indicator for the enterprise versus domestic percentage split (use indicator 10) or households without NAE (use indicator 11).

name: Expenditure (%) on broad durable goods acquired in last 365 days among the households having NAE
description: Expenditure (%) on broad durable goods acquired in last 365 days among the households having NAE
specification: Use this indicator when the query refers to percentage split of spending on each broad durable-goods group between enterprise and domestic use among NAE households, for rural and urban areas. Do not use this indicator for average MPCE or budget share in rupees (use indicator 9 or 11).

name: Average MPCE (in ₹) on different durable goods
description: Average MPCE (in ₹) on different durable goods
specification: Use this indicator only when the query asks for average monthly per capita expenditure (MPCE) in rupees on different broad groups of durable goods, for households having NAE, households not having NAE, or all households, across rural, urban and combined areas. Match queries containing terms such as 'average MPCE', 'average spending per person', 'average expenditure on furniture and fixtures', or 'average monthly expenditure on durable goods'. Do not use this indicator for the percentage or proportion of households acquiring durable goods (use indicators 7 or 8), budget share or expenditure percentage by enterprise versus domestic use (use indicators 9 or 10).
